statement: The system shall provide visual indicators on the MMI screens showing the range of motion for each joint and change colors when approaching soft limits.
The system shall display temperature-related warnings on the MMI screen if motors begin to overheat during operation.
The system shall not include audio alarms or haptic feedback for joint limit warnings.
The system shall support pre-programmed movements for large-scale transitions between tasks, such as moving along an imaginary rail or returning to a home position.
The system shall allow the operator to take manual control after a pre-programmed movement brings the arm close to the target location.
The system shall provide a ghost mode that visually predicts the final position of the boom or arm before execution to allow verification of commands.
The system shall implement no-go zones in software to prevent movement into areas where damage could occur, such as near electrical connectors or junction boxes.
The system shall provide audible alarms when the operator attempts to enter a defined no-go zone.
The system shall support both fixed camera views and variable viewpoints to assist with depth perception and task alignment.
The system shall allow camera views to zoom in and out dynamically based on proximity to the task.
The system shall support augmented reality overlays on the display to guide alignment or focus during new or complex tasks.
The system shall prioritize image resolution over frame rate in video feedback.
The system shall provide force feedback to the operator to indicate resistance or obstruction during movement.
The system shall have minimal latency between operator input and mechanical response.
The system shall operate at the operator's own pace without time-sensitive requirements.
The system shall model the entire operational environment in simulation to plan for worst-case scenarios.
The system shall use computer vision to recognize different materials such as aluminium, rubber, and painted surfaces.
The system shall use material recognition to inform no-go zones or gripping instructions based on visual identification.
The system shall map unknown environments and identify restricted areas based on material composition.
The system shall include robust tendon design with improved coatings or gauges to enhance durability.
The system shall use a gripper design with pins and positive locking features to ensure secure grasping and build operator trust.
